title: Summary (roll-up) fields added by an upgrade read null on rows stored before it until a child row is written
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Filing gate: ① observed. Found in the cloud seat's local HotCRM 6.2.0 → 6.4.0 upgrade test (2026-11-15, cloud `2a08986`, objectstack 18.5.0 `b914e7247f69`), ordered by the maintainer.

## Defect

HotCRM 6.3.0's o2c module adds `summary` roll-ups through `objectExtensions`: crm_contract `planned_amount`, `invoiced_amount`, `received_amount`, `receivable_balance`, and three on crm_account. After the upgrade:

- contracts and accounts stored BEFORE it read `null` for every roll-up (`GET /api/v1/data/crm_contract/ID`), and the record page folds them under "Show 5 empty fields";
- a contract created AFTER the upgrade reads `0` for all four;
- a pre-upgrade row fills in only when one of its billing milestones, invoices or payments is written (CTR-0005 then read 36000 / 36000 / 20000 / 16000, which is correct).

So the same empty state reads `null` or `0` depending on when the row was made, and an existing customer sees blank balances until something moves. No backfill covers it, and HotCRM's changelog says nothing about it.

## What done looks like

- When a package install or upgrade adds a summary field, the platform materialises it for the rows that already exist (or computes it on read), so a pre-existing row reads what a new row with the same children reads.
- A pin test: add a summary field to an object with existing parent and child rows; every parent reads the computed value without any child write.
- If materialising existing rows is ruled out, say so here, and HotCRM's 6.4.0 notes get a line saying when balances appear.
